name: stimulus
description: Stimulus set identifier (name of the stimulus file)

name: corr_thre
description: Split-half correlation threshold for selecting reliably responsive neurons

name: n_procs
description: Dimensionality of the equivariant subspace projection used for decoding

name: n_neurons
description: Number of neurons randomly subsampled per draw

name: inv_snr
description: Inverse signal-to-noise ratio; noise std = sqrt(inv_snr) * response std

name: n_max
description: Maximum number of random neuron subsamples per condition

name: noise_model
description: Noise model added to responses (gaussian, poisson, or mult_gain)
